title: CodeX Client
description: A modern Minecraft utility client focused on performance, customization, and quality-of-life features like - Toggle Sprint, ClickGUI, Keystrokes, Armor Status, FPS & Ping, Zoom, Potion Effects, Time Changer, Fullbright, Custom Crosshair, Block Overlay
body: CodeX Client is a modern Minecraft utility client focused on performance, customization, and quality-of-life enhancements. Built with a clean design philosophy, it delivers useful features, smooth gameplay, and an intuitive user experience while staying lightweight and responsive. Whether you're optimizing performance or customizing your playstyle, CodeX Client provides the tools to make Minecraft feel better than ever.
